name: TC-175: a frozen gift card is rejected
description: A gift card frozen by an admin is rejected at checkout with a 'frozen' error.
descriptionHtml: A gift card frozen by an admin is rejected at checkout with a 'frozen' error.

testStage.description: A gift card frozen by an admin is rejected at checkout with a 'frozen' error.

steps.name: Seed a gift card and freeze it
Wait for selector getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByPlaceholder('Enter your gift card number')
Fill "AUTOGCMUS0D1AJ3BOAGL" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByPlaceholder('Enter your gift card number')
Click getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply', exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').locator('p.text-red-500')
Expect "toHaveCount" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByText(/Gift card applied: -\$\d/)
